question: Which of the following scientists provided the Law of Octaves?
solution:
The Correct answer is__** ​John Newlands**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Newlands **observed that when the chemical elements are arranged according to** increasing atomic weight, **
 
• Elements with similar physical and chemical properties occur after each interval of **seven elements.**
 
• This pattern repeated every **eight elements**, much like the octaves on a piano, hence the name ** “Law of Octaves”**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Galileo Galilei:**

 
• Galileo is often hailed as the father of** observational astronomy**
 
• Galileo formulated the basic law of **falling bodies**, which he verified through meticulous measurements.
 
• Galileo invented various** military compasses.**
 
• He was one of the earliest developers of the** thermoscope**

**​Michael Faraday:**

 
• Faraday discovered the principles of** diamagnetism** and the **laws of electrolysis.**
 
• Faraday’s inventions of **electromagnetic rotary devices** formed the basis for **electric motor** technology.
 
• Michael Faraday was the first scientist to discover** benzene** in 1825.

**Marie Curie:** 

 
• Marie and Pierre Curie explored** radioactive **materials and their properties.
 
• She developed techniques to isolate** polonium and radium.**
 
• Marie Curie was the** first woman** to win a Nobel Prize and remains the** only person** to win **Nobel Prizes in two scientific fields.**
